entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, with VeloFit support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return a VeloBand GPS tracker I bought.

I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you please provide me with your order number? And just to be clear, is there a technical fault with the band, or is this more of a preference issue?
The order number is VF887-21. And no, it works fine. I just... I changed my mind. It was a total impulse buy and I just don't use it.

Okay, thank you for that information, I've pulled up your order. I see you purchased the new VeloBand Pulse, which was delivered 14 days ago, on January 5th. I do need to make you aware of the specific return policy for this item.
What policy? Just process the return. I want my money back.
I understand. However, due to the nature of the device, the VeloBand Pulse has a strict 10-day return window from the date of delivery. Because you are on day 14, we are unable to process a refund.
ARE YOU KIDDING ME? Ten days?! That's absolutely insane! What kind of garbage policy is that? This is unacceptable! I want to speak to your manager right now.

I am a senior agent and empowered to handle this for you. I certainly understand your frustration, but the policy is in place because once the device is activated, it links to a personal account, and for hygiene reasons, we cannot accept them back after that initial 10-day period.

I don't care about your hygiene reasons! I spent good money on this thing and I'm not using it. I'm going to blast VeloFit all over social media and every review site I can find. This is highway robbery!

I hear your frustration, and while a direct return to VeloFit for a refund isn't an option, I do have a great alternative for you. We run an official VeloFit Resale Marketplace, which is very popular with our community.
What the hell is a resale marketplace? You just want to pawn me off on someone else.

Not at all. It's our own secure platform where you can sell your VeloBand Pulse directly to another VeloFit enthusiast. Since the device is new and in-demand, our customers often recoup most of their original cost. It's a much better option than being stuck with a product you don't use.
So... I can sell it myself on your site? And you guys handle the transaction to make sure it's safe?
Exactly. We facilitate the platform to ensure everything is secure for both the buyer and the seller. It's the best way to get value back for your device outside the return window.
Hmph. Fine. I guess that's better than nothing. Send me the information on that.
Of course. I'm sending an email to the address on file right now with a direct link and instructions for the VeloFit Resale Marketplace. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's it. Just make sure I get that email.
It's on its way. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a great rest of your day.
